metadata.notes: Mapper catalogue rewritten for construct vocabulary (vlan, mac-vrf, ip-vrf, acl).

vlan.description: Map a local broadcast domain (VLAN) and the ports in it on one or more nodes.
examples: create a vlan 120 on leaf01 ethernet1 for tenant acme
put leaf01 ethernet2 into vlan 300 for tenant blue

mac-vrf.description: Map a VLAN extended over the fabric by an L2VNI with EVPN route-targets (MAC VRF).
examples: provision a mac vrf between leaf01 ethernet1 and leaf02 ethernet2 for tenant acme vlan 100
extend vlan 200 over the fabric as a mac-vrf for tenant acme

ip-vrf.description: Map a routed instance (IP VRF) with an L3VNI and route-targets.
examples: create an ip-vrf between leaf01 wan1 and leaf02 wan1 for tenant acme with prefix 10.0.10.0/24
provision a vrf for tenant blue across leaf01 and leaf02

acl.description: Map an access-list bound to the ports a service attaches on.
examples: allow tcp/443 from 10.0.0.0/24 on leaf01 ethernet1
deny all egress on leaf02 ethernet2
